status: Declared before estimator implementation and before any fitted predictions
data_source: Verified public Nordic Field Trial System treatment means only
target_interpretation: Signed relative treatment-associated grain response against the measured disease-control arm; disease-free absolute yield loss and an STB causal effect are not identified
yield_units: Native dt/ha or hkg/ha, 100 kg/ha; t/ha = native value * 0.1. Ratios use matched grain yields with the same moisture basis
negative_observations: Retain all signed R and all signed measured disease reductions; neither outcomes, predictors nor predictions are clipped

endpoint_cohort.eligibility: Both arms have measured final STB and measured zero yellow rust, brown rust, mildew and non-STB leaf spot at the same date and reported leaf scope; no positive co-pathogen value in either arm at any recorded date within that scope
endpoint_cohort.feature: Final STB percent coverage untreated minus disease-control, percentage points
endpoint_cohort.scope: Registry scope 0, leaf rank unspecified; no conversion to top-three leaf area

integral_cohort.eligibility: Endpoint cohort with at least two dates having numerical STB severity in both arms at the same reported leaf scope
integral_cohort.feature: Trapezoidal integral of untreated minus disease-control severity on their common dates only, percentage-days
integral_cohort.window: First to last common observed date; actual day spacing; no extrapolation or unmatched knots; windows retained individually
integral_cohort.interpretation: Paired common-date severity integral; healthy-area duration is not measured

four_disease_cohort.eligibility: Both arms have numerical STB, yellow rust, brown rust and mildew percent coverage on the final untreated STB date and the same reported leaf scope; missing is never zero; no yield-response selection
four_disease_cohort.non_STB_leaf_spot: Retain measured values as co-occurrence provenance; not a fifth predictor
four_disease_cohort.scope: All eligible source columns use unspecified leaf rank, percent coverage

estimators.single_feature: Origin-constrained weighted least squares with beta >= 0; beta = max(0, sum(w*x*R)/sum(w*x*x)), zero beta and a null-predictor flag if denominator is zero
estimators.four_disease: Origin-constrained nonnegative weighted least squares; signed covariate matrix; identically zero columns receive beta=0 and explicit null flags
estimators.model_selection: No model or hyperparameter selection; no ridge penalty is evaluated
estimators.baseline: Calibration-only mean R, each training trial contributing equal total weight

evaluation.primary: Leave one entire trial out. All cultivars and treatment arms from that trial, including arms sharing an untreated control, remain in the same fold
evaluation.fit_weight: Within each training set, each row receives 1 / number_of_rows_in_its_trial; each trial total equals one
evaluation.evaluation_weight: Each withheld trial contributes equal total weight; pooled mean loss is the arithmetic mean of trial mean losses
evaluation.temporal_challenge: Fit only 2020-2021 Informer trials 62693, 62768, 65793; test 2022 Pondus trial 68027, separately for the endpoint and integral domains
evaluation.uncertainty: No confidence intervals reconstructed from separate treatment-mean bounds; no independent-plot claim

transfer_limitations: Only four environments identify the strict-domain validation. Treatment-associated response with residual disease requires paired treated/untreated disease input. Different observed windows, unknown leaf ranks, genotype/year shifts and broad epidemic-to-climate transfer are not independently validated. Absolute grain loss is not promoted.
